title: John Lennon ordered to leave the US within 60 days | 1974
content:
John Lennon was ordered to leave the United States within 60 days on 17 July 1974.

The US Justice Department announced that the Board of Immigration Appeals had unanimously dismissed Lennon’s appeal against a similar ruling made on 23 March 1973, and he was once again ordered to leave the USA voluntarily within the specified time.

After studying the ruling, Lennon’s lawyer Leon Wildes lodged an appeal on his behalf.
